issues.reason: Summary table calls Hunter 'Skill training' and Keen Senses 'Skill bonus'; detailed names are Hunter and Keen Senses and should not be duplicated.
Alluring and Light Build replace ONLY one bonus in the racial score vector, not the entire vector. Partial replacement unsupported, disable until reviewed.
Feral says -2 Intelligence when the base race already has -2 INT and does not name a replacement standard feature. Must clarify stacking and feature substitution.
Loper grants +10 base speed as well as +10 for charge/run/withdraw and does not replace Sprinter. Requires precise movement composition; disabled for now.
Fleet-Footed Run bonus feat and +2 initiative need sheet integration; do not silently award incorrect skill or ability modifiers.
Cold/Heat Acclimated benefits depend on environmental conditions. Cold Acclimated adds Ice Resistance 5.
Beastkin Immunities protects only from magical sleep and against enfeebling effects, Fearless against fear. These are not generic all-save bonuses.

Standard testing supports printed STR/WIS/INT vector, identity, Hunter class skills, Perception, darkvision/low-light vision, seven optional languages, owned +1 natural armor/+2 initiative and a manual Run card. Magic-sleep immunity, enfeebling/fear saves and conditional Sprinter movement remain manual; no blanket save/speed/condition changes. Alternates and independent full review pending.

features.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
features.description: +2 STR, +2 WIS, -2 INT.

features.name: Size
features.description: Medium; do not double-count global size modifiers.

features.name: Type
features.description: Humanoid (beastkin).

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: 30-ft land speed. Sprinter grants additional speed only in specified actions.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Common and Beastmen. Bonus choices for high INT: Draconic, Dwarven, Elvaan, Galkan, Giant, Goblin, Orc.

features.name: Beastkin Immunities
features.description: Immune to magical sleep effects; +2 racial saving throws against enfeebling spells/effects.

features.name: Fearless
features.description: +2 racial saves against fear effects.

features.name: Natural Armor
features.description: +1 natural armor AC.

features.name: Fleet-Footed
features.description: Run bonus feat and +2 racial initiative bonus (sheet integration remains manual).

features.name: Hunter
features.description: Stealth and Survival are always class skills.

features.name: Keen Senses
features.description: +2 racial Perception.

features.name: Sprinter
features.description: +10 ft speed only during charge, run or withdraw actions.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: See in the dark up to 60 ft.

features.name: Low-Light Vision
features.description: See twice as far as humes in dim lighting.

features.name: Alluring
features.description: Replace only racial +2 WIS with +2 CHA; retain racial +2 STR and -2 INT. Partial ability-vector replacement.

features.name: Civilized
features.description: +2 Diplomacy and Sense Motive.

features.name: Cold Acclimated
features.description: Immune to environmental cold damage at temperatures below 40°F; treat extreme cold below 0°F as ordinary cold, plus ice resistance 5.

features.name: Feral
features.description: Always treat Perception and Stealth as class skills. Says starts with -2 Intelligence, already same as baseline; whether extra -2 INT applies and what is replaced are unstated.

features.name: Heat Acclimated
features.description: Automatically succeed Fortitude saves to avoid heat dangers through severe heat conditions.

features.name: Influential
features.description: +2 Diplomacy; +1 DC to enfeebling-school spells, not all spells.

features.name: Information Hunter
features.description: +2 Diplomacy specifically to gather information; Knowledge (local) becomes a class skill.

features.name: Light Build
features.description: Replace only +2 STR with +2 DEX; retain +2 WIS and -2 INT. Partial racial-vector replacement.

features.name: Loper
features.description: Base speed +10 ft (30 to 40), plus an additional +10 ft when charging, running or withdrawing. Does not list Sprinter as replaced; speed adapter required.

features.name: Scent
features.description: Gain Scent instead of Low-Light Vision; retain Darkvision.
